 Kazakhstan vs Slovakia Preview & Prediction | 2026-27 UEFA Nations League | League C
 by Alex Lawes · 14 November 2026 at 12:12 pm 
 Post 
 Share 
 Click here for today’s sports betting tips from our expert analysts! 
 Kazakhstan have endured a tough UEFA Nations League campaign as they now welcome League C Group 3 leaders Slovakia to the Astana Arena. 
 Kick-off date/time: 
 16 November 2026 at 3:00 pm 
 How to watch on TV:  UK – Not televised / USA – FOX Sports
 How to watch online:  UK – Cannot be streamed / USA – FOX Sports streaming platforms
 Key stats 
 Kazakhstan have won two of their three Nations League meetings with Slovakia, both in June 2022 (1-0 in Trnava and 2-1 in Nur-Sultan), but Slovakia won the most recent one 2-1 in Košice on Matchday 2 of this edition.
 Coming into Matchday 6, Slovakia have already secured top spot in Group C3 with 11 points, four clear of second-placed Moldova, while Kazakhstan are bottom on two points.
 Slovakia will finish top of a Nations League group for the first time in five editions; their previous best was second place in Group C1 in 2024/25.
 Kazakhstan can only climb off the bottom by beating Slovakia while Faroe Islands lose to Moldova – and with their head-to-head record against Faroe Islands level (1-1 and 2-2), overall goal difference (then goals scored) would decide it, with Kazakhstan starting three goals worse off (-3 to 0).
 Kazakhstan are winless in 12 Nations League matches (D3 L9), their longest such run in 31 Nations League games, since a 2-1 home win over Belarus in September 2022.
 Kazakhstan are also winless in five home Nations League matches (D2 L3) since that win over Belarus.
 Kazakhstan have lost all four of their previous Matchday 6 games in the Nations League, scoring two goals and conceding 12.
 Kazakhstan have scored in all five matches this edition (six goals) after failing to score in any of their six league-phase matches in 2024/25.
 Slovakia are unbeaten in five Nations League matches (W3 D2), their longest unbeaten run in 29 Nations League games.
 Slovakia's 11 goals this edition are already their most in a single Nations League campaign (previous high ten in 2024/25), and their 4-0 win in Moldova on Matchday 4 is their biggest Nations League victory.
 Slovakia have won five of their 14 away Nations League matches (W5 D2 L7), including their last one, that 4-0 win in Chisinau.
 David Strelec has scored five goals in 13 Nations League appearances, the most by a Slovakia player, while Abat Aimbetov has scored five goals in 18 Nations League appearances, the most by a Kazakhstan player.
 Kazakhstan vs Slovakia prediction 
 Kazakhstan succumbed to a 2-1 defeat to Moldova in Chisinau the other day to leave them still rock-bottom of League C Group 3 with just two points collected from their five matches during these autumn international breaks.
 Slovakia, coached by Vladimir Weiss Sr once again, will believe they are playing a level below where they should be, albeit they haven’t dominated their League C group with three wins and two draws – left frustrated by a 2-2 draw at home to the Faroe Islands the other day.
 Slovakia have to be deemed firm favourites for this one against a poor Kazakhstan side, even away from home in Eastern Europe on Monday.
 Kazakhstan vs Slovakia tip:  Slovakia to win
